retrievalProfile.description: A nostalgic 90s music aesthetic featuring a candid group portrait overlaid with heavy, swash-heavy custom lettering and subtle spiral background textures.
triggerTerms: swash script typography with group portrait
textured earth tone background with spirals

recipe.visualDefinition: A composition balancing a dynamic, walking group portrait against a gritty, textured urban background, unified by a prominent, stylized script logo in the lower third and faint decorative spiral overlays.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject movement contrasts with static textured background
Warm yellow typography pops against cool blue denim and dark clothing
Decorative spirals frame the subjects and integrate with the lettering style
Low-angle perspective emphasizes the subjects' presence
coreInvariants: Heavy, stylized swash-based lettering in the lower third
Textured, mottled background with faint spiral patterns
Warm, slightly desaturated color palette with golden highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in a walking pose, occupying the central and upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized yellow lettering in the bottom foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Leading from the subjects' forward motion on the left toward the right, then dropping down to the bold typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Utilized in the upper background to allow the textured wall and spirals to provide atmosphere.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones (browns, tans, grays) in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and blues in the subjects' clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright golden yellow for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the yellow text and dark clothing; low saturation in the background textures.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or primary brights except for the golden yellow accent.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight serif-based script with exaggerated swashes.
letterConstructionRules: Terminals end in tight, circular spirals
Thick, consistent stroke weight with slight modulation
Underlining swashes that connect or cradle the word forms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase initials feature oversized, decorative loops
Lowercase 'i' dots replaced with small circular flourishes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stand-alone decorative logo; if secondary text is needed, use a clean, small-scale sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and spiral flourishes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a candid photograph of three women walking in a line against a textured, mottled stone wall in earth tones. Add faint, light-colored spiral line art patterns as a low-opacity overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, custom-lettered logo in golden yellow at the bottom, featuring heavy strokes and spiral-shaped swashes on the terminals.

verificationChecks: Does the text have spiral flourishes on the ends of letters?
Is the background textured with a mottled, stone-like appearance?
Is the color of the main text a prominent golden yellow?
Are there faint decorative spirals in the background?

mustAchieve: Integration of text and background texture
Dynamic sense of motion in the subjects

postGenerationChecks: Check that the yellow text is legible against the background.
Ensure the spiral motifs do not distract from the subjects' faces.
Verify the grain/texture is consistent across the image.
Confirm the typography feels integrated into the lower third.
recipe.reuseFormula: Candid group motion + Mottled earth-tone texture + Spiral line-art overlays + Heavy golden swash-script = 90s Country Pop Aesthetic
